newsitem.title: USA: Utah Intermountain 875 MW unit back at full load.
newsitem.headline: Utah Intermountain 875 MW unit back at full load.

text.p: The 875 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Intermountain coal-fired power plant in Delta, Utah, was back at full load after being down for scheduled maintenance since early April, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Monday.
There was an outside chance the unit would need to be taken back down due to a vibration problem, but this was not certain, they said.
The plant's other 875 MW unit was said to be operating normally at rate of 836 MW.
Intermountain is owned and operated by Intermountain Power Service Corp, a consortium of mostly municipal utilities including the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.
Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment on the unit's status.
